main_text.p: prope Hamburgum inprimis, ubi vasto ore in Oceanum germanicum exoluitur. De nomine inter eruditos non conuenit, alio atq; alio eum appellantes. Paulus Iouius PifciumSilurum Aufonii exiftimauit : Hermolaus Hiccam apud Athen. alii Torfionem Plinii efse crediderunt, cuius etiam opinionis fuiffe Chriftoph. Longolium inuenio. Rondeletus his omnibus fcriptor recentior Accipenfe- rem Romanorum literis nobilitatu n Stu- nobilissi-rionem effe putauit, & Dorionis ?, five Galeni galaxian lib. ?aliment. Stacio igitur mire ingenia doctorum torfit, gulam interim fuauiter demulcens, boni enim fuanifque fucci eft, carnifque durae & candidae, adul- tioris vitulae carnibus haud abfimilis: vnde nutriendi vi Scurionem pollere certam eft, modo bene in ventre perficiatur, fecus enim negotium faceffit ventriculo. Coctus in acce- to feruatur ad aliquot dies. Praefertur mas in cibo: Sed foemina ouis grauida autorita- tem quoque retinuit. Quidam foeeum craffum & glutinofum eum obtinere ajunt, quod de crudo, vel etiam non probe coctae ac praeparato conceffero. Potro in magna fuiffe autoritate & honore in menfis Ros mus elimmanorum accipenferem teftatur Horatius accipen-l.2. ferm. fatyra 2. fic fcribens, fer. haud ita pridem.

page.notes: Scan is dim and blurred; many words in the body are doubtful and should be checked against the original. Marked readings include the Greek/italic word after "Dorionis" (printed as a Greek word for "dog-star-like" shape, not reliably readable) and "?aliment." Left margin words are small and partly illegible; "nobilissi-", "mus elim", "accipen-" and "fer." are read approximately. The Greek word after "Dorionis" is illegible on this scan and should be checked. The line "Pifcium" also needs checking.
